name: sd_node_catalog
description: SD 节点选型目录 + 动态查询。包含库节点的 sbs 文件名、输出端口、用途分类， 供 AI 选择合适的纹理源。详细参数和端口通过动态查询获取（永远准确）。 Use when AI needs to: (1) find the correct sbs filename for a library node, (2) choose appropriate noise/texture generators for a material, (3) dynamically query node params/ports before setting values. Substance Designer only (run_python).
author: ArtClaw
